digest.title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
digest.tldr: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse.  It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

digest.title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
digest.tldr: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

digest.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
digest.tldr: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.

digest.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
digest.tldr: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours battery life.
